subject: Run the full regression suite once, map every acceptance scenario to its evidence, and declare the release state
description:
MILESTONE f (release), last task.

WHY: the owner's goal (task 1). Every scenario has current evidence at the layer the spec names, each with a negative control, and the service provider is reported unqualified. One clean full run passes with no regression. Every capability entry is complete, and release evidence binds commit and working-tree hash. The spec: "Release is complete only when all required scenarios have current evidence and no unresolved required capability remains. A capability unavailable in the qualification environment is reported as unqualified until tested in an appropriate environment; it is never silently waived."

ORDER (no edits after the run; any edit reruns steps 2–4):
1. Reconcile first, and commit:
   - Docs/ToDo.md gets one line per item found and not fixed.
   - Review README.md, Docs/* and the ICD texts so every non-obvious constraint states its reason; correct any section still wrong.
   - qualification/metrics.json records contract digest sha256:baef98…, which no current contract has; it was stale before task 8 (found 2026-10-04). Regenerate it at the final contract with the command that owns it (`qualify --metrics` in packages/cli/src/commands.ts), or record it in Docs/ToDo.md with its reason.
   - Check the commit messages since task 1's HEAD with Loom's own patterns: `git log 1f5217d..HEAD --format=%B` through `prohibitedMarkers` (packages/core/dist/index.js) must report none.
2. Run once at that committed HEAD, with a clean tree, under the evidence rule: `evidence.mjs stamp 28`, then each suite with TAP into evidence\28. Every suite runs whatever the host load (task 1, owner rule of 2026-10-05); time limits are about three times the duration measured under load. From Tools/loom:
   - npm run build;
   - npm run self-test (its release-wording stage must report 0 markers);
   - npm run test:workspace, test:qualification, test:cli, test:mcp and test:fixtures;
   - npm run smoke:mcp;
   - node packages/cli/dist/index.js coverage --check --results <tap files> (0 findings);
   - node packages/cli/dist/index.js docs --check --self (0 findings).
   From apps/designer: npm run build; npx ng test --watch=false; npx playwright test.
   Afterwards `SqlLocalDB info` shows no loom-* instance. Then `evidence.mjs check 28` must print MATCH with every TAP ok.
   - KNOWN HOST RISK (2026-10-04): under CPU saturation the full designer ng test timed out 3 tests at vitest's 5,000 ms default (views.spec.ts, workflow.spec.ts; a different set on each run), and all 29 passed per spec file. A timeout is run again with a longer limit; one that recurs once the limit is three times the measured duration is a robustness defect at its owner: give the spec a timeout justified by its measured duration, with the reason in a comment, commit, and restart step 2. Never rerun until it passes.
3. Compare with the task 1 baseline. A new failure is a regression: fix it at its owner, commit, and restart from step 2.
4. Bind release evidence (ReleaseEvidence, task 26) to that HEAD and working-tree hash. Re-register the MCP server for this session if dist changed, then live-check initialize instructions, the tool list and one loom.workspace inspect. Claude Code is the client available on this host; both supported client classes are proven by smoke.
5. Run the plan gate: `findings 0`, every crosswalk statement mapped to a completed task. Re-measure the read-only state:
   - The loomrefinements.md SHA-256 must be unchanged.
   - Peer sessions change Tools/Context-Engineering. On 2026-10-04 15:40 its status showed modifications under claude-home/skills/claude-doctrine, desired-state, hooks, scripts, src and tests, and the deletion of skills/loom-engineering/*, all by the "Doctrine Improvements" session. So prove "no commit from this session touches Tools/Context-Engineering" from commits: no Loom or superproject commit of this session changes that path. The superproject's commits touch only the Tools/loom gitlink, so check with `git log --format=%H --author=<this session's commits> -- Tools/Context-Engineering` over the session's range. A porcelain diff against task 1's record cannot prove it.
6. Build the scenario-to-evidence matrix as a release-evidence record. Each row names its evidence at the spec's layer and its negative control.

| Scenario | Milestone | Evidence from tasks |
|---|---|---|
| Fresh agent connection | a | 10, 21, 29 |
| Resume after context loss | a | 10, 14, 21 |
| Different clients | a | 21, 29 |
| Several workspaces | a | 14, 21, 25 |
| Parent with nested components | b (views in c) | 11, 15, 35, 31 |
| Missing child or wrong digest | b | 11, 15, 35 |
| Child contract change | b | 11, 15, 35 |
| Runtime interaction cycle | b | 11 |
| Interrupted cross-repository write | b | 15, 35 |
| Terminal diagrams | c | 12, 20, 36 |
| Native SQL success | d | 16, 17, 32, 37 |
| Native SQL failure and cancellation | d | 16, 17, 37 |
| Laptop resource pressure | d | 16 |
| Actual implementation tests | d | 16 |
| Service provider | d | 18; unqualified on this host per decision 6c |
| Angular URL | e | 23, 24, 25 |
| Concurrent browser and agent edits | e | 24, 25 |
| Browser security | e | 23, 25 |
| Repository wording and drift | f | 3, 26 |

7. Declare the release state: "qualified except: service provider (needs a Developer-edition SQL service host)". Every other scenario must have current evidence; it never reads "complete" while a scenario is unqualified.
8. Try the push, then bump the superproject's Tools/loom pointer (task 1 protocol).

DONE WHEN: every suite passes with no regression against the baseline; coverage --check and docs --check --self report 0 findings; every capability entry is complete; release evidence binds the commit and working-tree hash; the plan gate prints `findings 0` with every statement mapped to a completed task; the release state is declared as in step 7.
activeForm: Running final regression and release check
